approved_decision.rationale: Current @hnk/glyphs authority distinguishes the two segments; FROZEN Y-bearing forms and DAYI depend on G40 identity; stale /j/ treatment in older HOYU metadata must be repaired downstream rather than used to rewrite G40 silently.

governance_decisions.decision: B1 approval does not define syllable boundaries, diphthongs, hiatus, glide formation, lexical stress or allophony.
B1 approval does not change safe romanization coverage; G16 romanization remains unresolved for B5.
B1 approval does not approve a canonical whole-word pronunciation for DAYI, HOYU, SARADAYA, TAYOVAN or VAMATAYA.
B1 approval does not change DAYI semantics, HOYU numeral semantics, morphology, grammar, productivity or curriculum slots.
No G40 reassignment is needed under B1; any future reassignment would require a separate explicit evidence/design gate.
